replication_classification.description: XAUUSD spot gold from HistData minute archives; same-period 2023 independent-source replication is historical source robustness, not future OOS

source.raw_timestamp_timezone: fixed EST UTC-05:00 without daylight-saving adjustment
source.timestamp_conversion: parse raw timestamp as fixed UTC-05:00, convert instant to UTC, then convert to America/New_York for frozen anchor matching
source.bar_timestamp_semantics: minute timestamp identifies the source minute bar

provenance_correction.reason: initial LFS OIDs were transcribed incorrectly; corrected directly from Git LFS pointer text at the already frozen repository commit

source.archive_granularity_note: full 2022 archive is materialized because the source is annual; the scorer discards anchors before 2022-11-01 and never uses them for baselines or inference

observation_grid.baseline_policy: each clock slot becomes scorable only after 20 prior valid same-source observations at that same New York clock slot

state_definition.realized_volatility: square root of sum of squared one-minute log close returns
state_definition.pre_rv_ratio: pre-60m realized volatility divided by trailing 20-valid-observation same-clock median pre-60m realized volatility
state_definition.future_rv_ratio: next-60m realized volatility divided by trailing 20-valid-observation same-clock median next-60m realized volatility
state_definition.future_range_ratio: next-60m high-low range divided by trailing 20-valid-observation same-clock median next-60m range
state_definition.primary_daily_effect: Spearman(pre_rv_ratio, future_rv_ratio) across valid frozen anchors on each New York date
state_definition.secondary_daily_effect: Spearman(pre_rv_ratio, future_range_ratio) across valid frozen anchors on each New York date

statistics.permutation_method: 20,000-epoch sign-flip test on daily primary effects against frozen positive sign

replication_gate.origin: unchanged from frozen MGC independent-replication gate

promotion_path_if_pass: integrate_with existing MGC robustness evidence without upgrading MGC breadth failure
separately_frozen monetization mechanism or future state shadow
leverage live only if executable economic gates later pass
